attach.reason: Extends the per-threat H2 sections this page already carries for the three new threats (their catalog facts are already assigned here) and the New Applicaton Credentials H2 (F032). Add table rows for Severity, Evidence, Rollup, and Exclusions after Definition, Example, and Trigger, and add one reported-changes table under Security Policy Weakening. Each threat gets an H2, not its own page: the page-structure guide's 'existing page answers the same reader question' rule applies, the catalog pattern in threatmanager/CLAUDE.md is one H2 per threat, and no existing threat has a page of its own. Generic rollup and exclusion mechanics stay on threatconfiguration.md; only values specific to each threat go here. Already UPDATE.

Upgrade-time behavior readers must know before they upgrade: First Time Location locations are purged and the threat is suspended 30 days (F045, F264, F265), and the next Entra ID sync is a full sync (F038). Page is already REWRITE (becomes the 3.3 to 3.4 upgrade). F264 and F265 are also on threats/entraid.md so the threat reader sees the suspension; link between them.

Registration response and the ServiceStatus endpoint are the server half of the remote-service status check this page already documents (F152-F160, F158). Already REWRITE. Customers never call them directly, so state them only as how the status check works.
The Report Only installer (F118, already assigned here) runs the License Service with -ro; same topic. Already UPDATE.
Report Only installs and the trial key are a licensing behavior; extends this page's licensing facts. Already UPDATE.
FullControl and the Administrators role belong with the roles and permissions on the User Access page. Already UPDATE.
Risky object sync split into RiskyUsers, RiskyServicePrincipals, RiskyAgents with a 1 minute wait, and display-name resync, are Entra ID Sync behavior. Already UPDATE.

Send Email action: email template date format with the viewer's offset (F033) and URL-safe /n handling in email summaries (F186) extend this page's Send Email and template facts (F182, F183, F187). Already UPDATE.
F321 (Originating Agent filter) is already here; F322 says the same filter applies to SIEM event queries. Already UPDATE.

The 3.4 copy is the seeded 3.3 page and documents 3.2 to 3.3. Keep upgrade_pg14_to_pg18.md and upgrade.md. Update links to the old filename inside 3.4.

proposals.recommendation: Create a new top-level api/ folder (label 'API', position 50, after Administration at 40) with a short overview.md page (what the REST API is, base URL, authentication via app token) before locations.md, or fold locations.md under administration/ if you do not want an API zone for one page.
